::: {.question-box}
How do I go from *using* bioinformatics tools to *writing* the code myself?
:::

## The plan

I've used many bioinformatics tools. Now I'm learning to build analyses from scratch, in small
daily steps, with everything committed to GitHub so the progress is visible.

![Five phases, October 2026 to May 2027.](plan.svg){fig-alt="Timeline of five phases: Restart, Core skills, Pipelines, Omics breadth, Independence"}

## How I learn

::: {.learned}
- Small daily wins: every task fits in 60–90 minutes.
- I type every line myself, and only look at answers after trying.
- One short blog post a week about what I built.
:::
